jobs.company: Metro One Loss Prevention Services Group (Guard Division), Inc.
jobs.description:
Dallas In-Person Hiring Event

Retail Unarmed Security Officer(s)


DATE: Thursday - August 20 2026

TIME: 1:00PM – 5:00PM

First Apply, Resume is Reviewed,

Then You Are Invited to Event


Metro One Security has the opportunity you’ve been looking for!

About Us:

At Metro One Security, we are reshaping the security industry with a dynamic, service-driven approach. We provide top-tier security and loss prevention services to our valued retail clients nationwide—and we’re growing fast. If you’re ready to join a company that values professionalism, integrity, and career growth, we’d love to meet you.


Why Attend Our Open House?

  • Meet directly with our recruiting team
  • Learn about available sites, shifts, and expectations
  • Immediate Interviews and take next steps toward employment
  • Get questions answered in real time

What We Offer:

  • Weekly Pay – Get paid fast for your hard work
  • Competitive Benefits – Medical, dental, vision, and more
  • Flexible Scheduling – We value work-life balance
  • 401(k) Program – Plan for your future
  • Easy Online Application Process – Quick and convenient

Your Responsibilities:

  • Provide exceptional customer service to clients and visitors
  • Monitor CCTV surveillance systems and complete accurate daily activity reports
  • Control access points and monitor security alarms
  • Observe, survey, and report activity at assigned posts
  • Respond appropriately to incidents and emergency situations

What We’re Looking For:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Authorized to work in the United States
  • Strong and stable work history, (No more than 3 jobs in last 6 years)
  • Bring UPDATED Resume to Event
  • Ability to stand for extended periods, (8hrs. or more)
  • Must pass a drug test and background screening
  • No Face, Neck or Hand Tattoos
  • Prior experience in security, military, corrections, or law enforcement is a plus
  • Valid Texas Security License required
  • Reliable transportation required


Grow your career. Strengthen your skills. Make a difference.


Metro One is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


Please bring the following with you:

  • A valid photo ID or Driver’s license
  • A current Texas Unarmed Security License
  • Social Security Card, Birth Certificate or Passport
  • Updated Resume

Business Casual attire, Required.
